newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total sets Philippines joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Total sets Philippines joint venture.

text.p: French oil company Total and Manila-based Hyatt Terminal and Industrial Corp (HTIC) signed an agreement to create a joint venture to import, store and market refined oil products in the Philippines, Total said on Tuesday.
The company, named Total Petroleum Philippines Corp, will be 60 percent owned by Total and 40 percent by HTIC .
The partners plan to establish a network of Total service stations throughout the country, at a rate of some 20 outlets a year for the next 10 years.
The joint venture will also sell fuel and gas oil to industries and electric power plants, and sell bunker fuel to ships in Manila Bay. It will also import and sell lubricants.
